Karthik — thanks for the heads up. Quick thoughts from product/legal ops: 

- HIPAA: We should not broadly accept a full HIPAA carve-in unless we already have a HIPAA program (we do not for this product). However, we can offer a scoped clause: accept responsibility for securing the specific payment transaction subset they identify, with an indemnity cap carveout and limited throughput obligations. Suggest: "Redwood will treat Customer-designated payment data elements as regulated data for the purposes of the DPA" (customer to define elements in an annex). That gives them comfort without exposing us to broad HIPAA compliance.

- SCCs / transfers: We already have EU SCCs in our contract library and the new model clauses addenda; legal can provide the addendum. We'll confirm the administrative checkbox for the EU-US framework but cannot rely on it as sole basis.

- Signature routing: From a risk/controls perspective we're okay with exec signature but would prefer a two-step: procurement signs SOW, legal finalizes DPA, then exec (VP/GC) signs summary cert so they get the corporate attestation they need. This reduces the chance of operational delays.

I'll draft proposed counter language and a short memo for the VP/GC to sign. Jan 19 (typo?) — meant Feb 19 — we can get that memo ready for review by end of day tomorrow if legal prioritizes.

Rishi
Head of Platform Legal Ops (on this thread)

Olivia — thanks for the redlines and the routing note. Apologies for the slightly delayed response; we've reviewed with legal ops and product security. Please see our proposed responses attached (Finex_DPA_redlines_v3_Redwood_comments.pdf) and the signature routing we can accept: 

- Commercial SOW: Procurement (Finex) + Sales (Redwood)
- DPA: Legal sign (Redwood) + Exec attestation (VP of GTM or GC) if required; Redwood legal will provide a short attestation memo for the exec to sign to satisfy Finex's internal process.

On HIPAA: We are willing to accept a narrowly scoped "regulated-data" annex: Finex to define the exact payment telemetry fields in Appendix A and we will treat only those elements as subject to additional safeguards. This will be limited to the Services described in the SOW and will include an indemnity cap (mutually acceptable), and an obligation for Finex to notify Redwood promptly of regulatory changes.

On SCCs/transfers: We will attach the EU SCC addendum; for the EU-US transfers we will execute the standard addendum and provide the documented legal basis.

Next steps: 1) Finex to confirm Appendix A fields and accept Redwood's annex language; 2) Procurement to sign SOW; 3) Redwood legal to produce attestation memo for exec signature if required.

I've attached the comments and the signature routing document. If acceptable, Karthik/Marissa — please confirm and we'll route for execution immediately.

Regards,
